svg.title: How RecallSpring works
svg.desc: You study in your own assistant (Claude, Codex, Antigravity or ChatGPT). It talks to RecallSpring on your computer through the MCP connector. RecallSpring keeps your material, notes, answers and history, schedules reviews and keeps every grade. You can also open RecallSpring yourself for the next step.
svg.text: or open it yourself: the next step, one button
on the plan you already have
